d:
Step into Egypt’s ancient Valley of the Nobles in this compilation episode of Lost Treasures of Egypt from National Geographic. Join world-leading archaeologists as they unearth the lives of a royal nurse, two ancient children, and a woman who served the rich and famous.
This episode offers a rare look into what everyday life, social hierarchy, and luxury were really like for ancient Egyptians. Discover how these figures navigated high-society and secured their own path to the afterlife.
